correctness.rationale: Exact conditional spin expectation produces the finite tridiagonal killed-Neumann Laplacian. Half-integer cosine eigenfunctions give an orthogonal mode expansion with positive normalized weights. The explicit inverse-Laplacian Green vector yields the integrated polynomial. A uniform summable mode-weight majorant and fixed-mode eigenvalue asymptotics rigorously establish the cubic profile and threshold exponent. Direct full-state rational checks and eigen/Green checks in packaged code passed 21378 assertions; diagnostics are not the proof.
